newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seesaw to end lower, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seesaw to end lower, seen down.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before ending lower on Monday, and dealers said an uncertainty on the economic front would keep the prices under pressure on Tuesday.
They said major players were cautious amid uncertainty about details of a proposed IMF-inspired reform package that the government was likely to unveil in the next few days.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 4.34 points, or 0.32 percent, to end at 1,363.26 after rising to 1,371.60 in early trade.
